correctness.rationale: The exact factorial moments follow from contracting prescribed adjacency edges. A known Poisson domination gives a monotone coupling with gap conditional mean 1/k and second moment at most 3/k. Geometric state occupation yields logarithmic L2 cumulative error; the idle indicator difference is pointwise bounded by the increment gap, and the remaining running time is likewise controlled. A Poisson renewal stopping-time expansion reduces the bivariate limit to an iid vector with covariance entries 1, 2exp(-1), exp(-1)+2exp(-2). A reproducible finite checker passes 159 assertions; these are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Idle rounds are the natural wasted-reshuffle count in a stochastic coalescence algorithm. The bivariate covariance determines fluctuations and dependence of wasted and total work, not inferable from marginal total-time convergence. The strong two-dimensional Poisson comparison is also structurally meaningful.
